title: ranní běh: postav, nahraj, zapiš, ukliď
interface:
final class Drupal\api_csobrec\Service\Application. Constructor (DayRun $dayRun, SftpUploader $uploader, SentLedger $ledger, Naming $naming, \Drupal\api_csobrec\Sftp\SftpSessionFactoryInterface $sessions, \Drupal\Core\File\FileSystemInterface $fileSystem, \Drupal\Core\Config\ConfigFactoryInterface $configFactory, \Drupal\Core\Logger\LoggerChannelFactoryInterface $loggerFactory).

run(\DateTimeImmutable $day, bool $upload = TRUE, bool $force = FALSE, ?\DateTimeImmutable $batchTime = NULL): array
$batchTime defaults to 'now'; it is the batch's name and its folder, so a test can pin it. The ORDER of what follows is the whole safety of this transfer and must not be rearranged.

1. Has this day already gone out? $ledger->lastBatchOfDay($day): when there is a row whose stav is 'odeslano' and $force is FALSE, return ['skipped' => TRUE, 'batch' => <that row's jmeno>] and do nothing else — no connection is opened, nothing is downloaded. Their importer refuses a second batch for the same day. A row with stav 'chyba' or 'preskoceno' does NOT block the day: a failed morning must not lock the day out for good.

2. The two directories, both derived from the day and $batchTime so a forced second run can never share a folder with the first: the batch is 'private://api_csobrec/davky/<Y-m-d>/<His of $batchTime>' and the work goes into 'private://api_csobrec/prac/<Y-m-d>/<His>'. Prepare the WORK one with prepareDirectory(CREATE_DIRECTORY | MODIFY_PERMISSIONS) and hand its REAL path to the day run, because ffmpeg cannot write into a stream wrapper. Do not create the batch directory here — the builder creates it, and a day with nothing to send must leave no empty folder behind.

3. $dayRun->build($day, $batchTime, <batch uri>, <work path>).

4. Write the batch down as started: $ledger->openBatch($day, $naming->batch($batchTime), <the run's inBatch>) and keep the id. This happens whether or not anything will be uploaded, so a failed or an empty morning is visible in the overview instead of leaving no trace.

5. Nothing to send (the run's 'batch' is NULL), or $upload is FALSE: $ledger->skipBatch(<id>, <why, in Czech, counts only>), delete nothing, write nothing into api_csobrec_odeslano, and return the run's counts with 'uploaded' => 0. A quiet day and a broken run must not look the same in the overview, and a test run ($upload FALSE) must leave the batch on disk to be looked at while claiming nothing was handed over.

6. Otherwise upload, and only then write it down. An empty api_csobrec.settings:sftp_cil is \RuntimeException naming the setting, handled exactly like a failed transfer below — without a target path the batch would be uploaded into the session's home directory, where nobody looks. $sessions->open() once, $uploader->upload(<the session>, <real path of the batch directory>, api_csobrec.settings:sftp_cil). ANY \Throwable from the open or the upload: $ledger->failBatch(<id>, <the message>), leave the working files where they are (that is what the diagnosis is done from), nothing goes into api_csobrec_odeslano, and rethrow — a transfer that did not happen must not be reported as a success. Only after the upload returns: $ledger->record($naming->batch($batchTime), <the run's activities>) when there is at least one row, then $ledger->finishBatch(<id>, <number of uploaded files>, <the batch's bytes>). The ledger is what tells tomorrow's run what ČSOB already has, so it is written only about files that really arrived.

7. The clean-up. With the upload behind us, delete the work directory of that day ('private://api_csobrec/prac/<Y-m-d>', the whole tree) — customer audio on our disk is a liability and the batch folder stays as the proof of what was handed over.

RETURNS the day run's counts (every one of them an int) plus 'uploaded' => <number of files that arrived> and 'batch' => <the batch name>, and nothing else: no 'activities', no nested batch array, nothing but numbers and that name, because the result is printed and logged. The 'skipped' key exists ONLY in the case of step 1.

prune(\DateTimeImmutable $now): int
Clears finished batches off the disk. api_csobrec.settings:davky_dni is the number of days to keep; 0 (or less) means keep everything and returns 0 without touching anything. Otherwise, in BOTH 'private://api_csobrec/davky' and 'private://api_csobrec/prac', delete every immediate subdirectory whose name is a 'Y-m-d' date strictly older than $now minus that many days, and return how many directories were deleted (a day in both places counts twice). A name that is not a date is left alone — somebody put it there on purpose. The ledger is NEVER touched: the disk is cleared, the record of what ČSOB received is forever.
